ev.q: Eleven persons were treated in an ED, and five were admitted to the hospital.
Eleven persons were treated in an ED, and five were admitted to the hospital.
Duration of illness ranged from 10 hours to 45 days (mean: 6.6 days; median 24 hours).
Symptom onset occurred 30 minutes to approximately 8 hours after ingestion of fish (median: 2 hours).
Investigators defined a case as tingling or numbness in the mouth and/or lips
